title: Heat generated
description: Essential: The answer must correctly state the heat generated as Q = μ m g L.

title: Iron block KE increase
description: Essential: The answer must correctly state the increase in kinetic energy of the small block as μ m g (l - L).

title: Wooden block KE loss
description: Essential: The answer must correctly state the kinetic energy lost by the wooden block as μ m g l.

title: System mechanical energy reduction
description: Essential: The answer must correctly state the reduction in the system's mechanical energy as μ m g L.

title: Friction work interpretation
description: Important: The solution must correctly relate the heat generated to the work done by kinetic friction over the relative displacement L.

title: Work-energy application
description: Important: The solution must apply the work-energy theorem separately to each block, using the correct displacement relative to the ground for the work done by friction.

title: Relative displacement use
description: Important: The solution must correctly identify and use the relationship between the displacements of the two blocks (l and L) to find their final common velocity or individual energy changes.

title: Sign error in energy change
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student incorrectly assigns a sign (e.g., states a loss as a gain) for the kinetic energy change of the wooden block.

title: Confusion of displacements
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student uses the wrong displacement (e.g., uses L instead of l, or vice versa) in the work-energy equations for the individual blocks.

title: Conservation check
description: Optional: The solution may verify that the reduction in system mechanical energy equals the sum of the heat generated and the net change in kinetic energy of the blocks.
